Project Modules

Back to documentation home

notes.models

Defines the Note model that stores the title, content, and creation timestamp for each sticky note.

notes.forms

Contains the NoteForm model form used to create and update note entries through the application interface.

notes.views

Contains the function-based views for listing notes, displaying note details, creating new notes, editing existing notes, and deleting notes.

notes.urls

Defines the application URL routes and connects each route to the correct view function.

sticky_notes.settings

Contains the main Django project settings, including installed applications, middleware, database configuration, templates, and static files.
